title: OutSafe-Bench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Offensive Content Detection in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as part of the 'Prejudice and Discrimination' and 'Violence and Hatred' categories in the OutSafe-Bench test suite, using multimodal prompts (from datasets like BBQ and SWSR). MLLM outputs are scored on a 0-9 risk scale by an automated multi-reviewer framework (FairScore) leveraging LLMs as judges.

Assessed using multimodal prompts from datasets like FairFace, PascalVoc, and MultiHateClip to trigger racial prejudice, with the safety of model outputs evaluated and scored by a weighted ensemble of LLM judges.
Measured under the 'Prejudice and Discrimination' risk category using multimodal inputs, where generated responses are evaluated for ageist stereotypes by an adaptive jury of peer LLMs.
Tested using multimodal inputs designed to elicit religious prejudice, evaluated by an automated LLM jury framework (FairScore) that assigns risk scores based on the presence of discrimination.
Evaluated by prompting models with multimodal inputs related to disability and assessing the generated output for discriminatory content using the FairScore LLM-as-a-judge system.
Assessed as a dimension of the 'Prejudice and Discrimination' category, using multimodal prompts that may elicit appearance-based prejudice, scored by a jury of top-performing LLMs.

Measured by feeding multimodal prompts related to sexual orientation to models and evaluating the outputs for discriminatory or prejudiced language/content using a weighted multi-model evaluation system.
